acceptanceCriteria: The root cause is identified with file:line evidence and either a product fix with a regression test forcing the interleaving, or a deterministic test fix that keeps what the case proves.

body: Context: Go 1.27.1, GitHub macos-15, make gate, 2026-10-05, release candidate da78c1572211a85e6c9944adb98350d69964eb9b, release-gates run 37381427566 job 112004121660. TestStableS0EPublicCases/normal-exit-lingering-descendant-contained (internal/cem/verify/stable_repository_unix_test.go:478) got exit 2, outcome UNSUPPORTED, code git-diff-failed, stage repository, 8 of 21 operations, in 0.08s; expected ACCEPT. It passes 30/30 locally on an idle Apple-silicon host. Suspected (not confirmed) a contained-descendant retirement race on a slower 3-vCPU runner. Root cause under diagnosis.
title: S0E normal-exit-lingering-descendant-contained fails git-diff-failed on the hosted macOS runner
